tissue_detail: primary root apex (1.5 cm from tip)
stage: 3-d-old germinated seedlings + 24 h N-deprivation + 24 h treatment
growth_system: hydroponic (Hoagland-based nutrient solution, grown as Ravazzolo2020), growth chamber 14/10 h, 25/18 C
curation_note: mapped by GSM5259779 ’NO3-+cPTIO_Rep1’, GEO treatment ’cPTIO’. 1 mM KNO3 + 1 mM cPTIO (NO scavenger). The -N and +NO3- controls are Ravazzolo2020 samples (SRR10669772-77, curated there); the GSE173102 ’re-analyzed’ re-uploads SRR14300957-62 are excluded as duplicates. N rank 2 is relative to the borrowed -N controls (rank 1). Paper kept only 2 of 3 cPTIO replicates after QC (which one not stated). SRA says HiSeq 2500 (paper NextSeq500), SE 75/76; submitted Apr 2021, separate from the Dec 2019 controls.
